$comment: Third-party semanticIds this crate may emit, and those it has evaluated.
An `allowlist` entry asserts to a machine that one of our elements means
what a standards body says its identifier means. That is a claim about
another organisation's vocabulary, so it is recorded only once a person has
Identifiers in the urn:odal-node: namespace need no entry — they name our
own concepts, and the gate accepts them by prefix.
`tracked` holds identifiers that were evaluated and not adopted, with the
correct value where it is known. Nothing there is permitted: the gate reads
`allowlist` only, and a test asserts every tracked identifier is refused.
Both sections have a fixed key set, enforced by a test. Every entry carries
every key of its section; null means not established.
allowlist: authority, source, release, meaning, usedFor, licence,
tracked:   authority, source, usedFor, status, checkedOn, finding,

urn:samm:io.catenax.battery.battery_pass.finding: Identifier is well-formed, released, and current at 6.0.0. Correspondence between the aspect model's field set and this crate's battery submodel was not established, so the semantic claim is unsupported.
urn:samm:io.catenax.battery.battery_pass.licence: CC-BY-4.0. Eclipse Foundation governance; no membership required to use the models. Attribution applies to reuse of model content, not to referencing the identifier.
urn:samm:io.catenax.battery.battery_pass.nextStep: Compare the aspect model's field set against BatteryTechnicalData. If they correspond, restore the constant and add an allowlist entry with a named reader.

https://admin-shell.io/IDTA/02006/2/0.finding: Form does not match the scheme IDTA publishes: their semanticIds are name-based, and this is the specification's document number expressed as a URI. The referenced version is also superseded — Digital Nameplate v3.0.1 is current.
https://admin-shell.io/IDTA/02006/2/0.nextStep: Read IDTA 02006 v3.0.1 for its declared semanticId and confirm the Nameplate template matches what this submodel carries.

https://admin-shell.io/IDTA/02004/1/2/Ma.usedFor: ManufacturerInformation submodel and manufacturer name property
https://admin-shell.io/IDTA/02004/1/2/Ma.finding: Document-number form, with a '/Manufacturer' path segment that is not part of any published identifier. IDTA 02004 Handover Documentation v2.0.1 is current.
https://admin-shell.io/IDTA/02004/1/2/Ma.nextStep: Read IDTA 02004 v2.0.1 for its declared semanticId, and confirm Handover Documentation is the right template for manufacturer information.

https://admin-shell.io/IDTA/02023/0/9.finding: Document-number form. The 0.9 release is superseded by Carbon Footprint v1.0 (March 2025) and v1.0.1.
https://admin-shell.io/IDTA/02023/0/9.nextStep: Adopt the current release rather than the 0/9 identifier recorded here; read v1.0.1 for its declared semanticId.

https://admin-shell.io/IDTA/02011/1/0.finding: Document-number form, and the template was misidentified: IDTA 02011 is 'Generic Frame for Technical Data for Industrial Equipment in Manufacturing', not a physical-properties template.
https://admin-shell.io/IDTA/02011/1/0.nextStep: Establish whether Technical Data is the right template for material composition before adopting its identifier.

urn:eclass:0173-1#01-AKJ975#001.usedFor: Repairability submodel and repairabilityScore property (EN 45554 index)
urn:eclass:0173-1#01-AKJ975#001.finding: 'urn:eclass:' is not a scheme ECLASS publishes. The Code Space Identifier is also wrong for the use: in 0173-1#0X-…, 01 denotes a Classification Class and 02 denotes a Property, and this was attached to a Property.
urn:eclass:0173-1#01-AKJ975#001.nextStep: With ECLASS Advanced access, locate the Property (02-space) IRDI for the EN 45554 repairability index specifically.

urn:idta:aas:submodel:digital-product-pa.finding: No 'urn:idta:' scheme is published; IDTA uses https://admin-shell.io/ URLs. IDTA-02099-1 'Digital Product Passport – Part 1: Metadata' declares the identifier recorded below and implements the EN 18223:2026 header fields.
urn:idta:aas:submodel:digital-product-pa.nextStep: Evaluate IDTA-02099-1 for the generic passport submodel; its scope is DPP metadata rather than arbitrary sector payloads, so confirm the fit first.
